Open Positions

Open is one row per symbol+system: average cost across add-on buys, first buy date. Trims reduce shares only (no Closed row) until remaining shares hit zero. Rows come from gettarget_positions.csv (system purchases) plus any other open lots ≥ $47.5K that are not listed in personal_holdings_exclude.csv or sold_symbols_blocklist.csv. Prices refresh via yfinance when stale (>55 min) during 9:30 AM–5:00 PM ET; after 5 PM ET/weekends uses getTarget_output.csv. Target/stop from getTarget.
